About Plane
Plane is an incisive response to config-heavy, opinionated, and restrictive project management software. Check out our website.

In just two years, Plane’s grown to #1 in its category on GitHub and become a viable open-core alternative to Jira, Monday, Wrike, Asana, ClickUp, and Linear, not to mention all-in-one tools like Notion or Obsidian.

Our growth has come on the back of the product’s true flexibility without artificial limits, simple configurations that work out of the box, and thoughtfully packaged features that nurture our customers’ growth instead of punishing it.
As a modern product start-up, we obsess over new and power users equally. Our mission is to empower teams everywhere with the simplest, most delightful work management experience on the planet. Our vision is to become the WorkOS of the future with a workbench of unified tools and techniques that intuitively and progressively form a greater whole for knowledge workers.

We’re well capitalized, backed by OSS Capital, and are revenue-positive. Our coworkers include ex-Microsoft, Deloitte, [24]7, Nutanix, and Yahoo! in our 50+ strong human force today.
About the Role
We're looking for a Junior Frontend Engineer who is early in their career but already shows real hunger for the craft of building software. This is a role for someone who wants to work on a product that thousands of teams rely on, learn from engineers who care deeply about quality, and grow quickly by taking on meaningful, well-scoped problems.

You won't just be picking up tickets. You'll contribute to real user-facing features, pair with senior engineers on harder problems, and steadily take on more ownership as you grow. Our expectation is that within a year, you'll be shipping features end-to-end with confidence.
You'll work directly with designers, product managers, and other engineers in a tight feedback loop, and your work will reach hundreds of thousands of users and thousands of teams globally.
What You'll Do
Build user-facing features. Implement user-facing features across our product, contributing to UI components, data models, and API integrations. You'll start with well-scoped work and gradually take on larger, more ambitious surfaces as you grow.
Contribute to our sync and real-time collaboration layer. Work alongside senior engineers to help extend our data synchronization mechanism and collaborative editing tools, which use a local-first architecture. You'll learn how modern sync engines, serialization, and conflict resolution actually work in production.
Learn and apply browser-level performance techniques. Get hands-on with Service Workers and IndexedDB for caching, and contribute to making Plane feel fast on slow networks and functional when users are offline.
Help push UI performance. Profile and optimize rendering paths — virtualization, memoization, selective re-renders — guided by senior engineers and our performance goals. Complex, dense views are a core part of Plane, and keeping them smooth is a shared responsibility.
Add instrumentation to what you ship. Help build out analytics, monitoring, and alerting around new features so the team can spot issues early. You'll learn to think about observability as part of shipping, not as an afterthought.
Work with our TypeScript tooling and build pipeline. Get comfortable with Vite and Rolldown, and contribute to keeping our developer experience fast and our production bundles lean.
Participate in our open-source work. Plane is open-source at its core. You'll contribute patches, review community PRs, and help us maintain a healthy public codebase.
Grow into strong engineering habits. Write clear code, ask good questions in reviews, document your work, and adopt the testing and review practices of a senior engineering team from day one.
What You'll Bring
2–4 years of professional frontend experience, with a portfolio of work (production apps, side projects, or open-source contributions) that shows you can ship real software.
Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and React. You're comfortable with modern React — hooks, component composition, context — and you write TypeScript with intent rather than just appeasing the compiler.
Working understanding of routing and state management. Practical experience with React Router and at least one client-side state management library (MobX, Redux, Zustand, or similar). You should be able to reason about when state belongs local vs. global and how reactivity flows through your app.
Comfort writing modern CSS. You can build responsive, themeable UIs and are comfortable with utility-first CSS (Tailwind) or a similar modern approach.
Good instincts for design and UI details. You don't have to be a designer, but you should notice when something feels off — a misaligned element, a clumsy empty state, a jarring transition — and care enough to fix it.
A curious, prototyping mindset. You're the kind of engineer who'd rather build a small, working version of an idea than argue about it in the abstract.
Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team. You can take ownership of a task, ask good clarifying questions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction.
Attention to detail and a craft mindset. You care about the small things — the empty states, the loading behavior, the micro-interactions — because they add up to how the product feels.
A learner's attitude. You're eager to pick up new tools, unafraid to ask questions, and open to feedback in code review and beyond.
Nice to Have
Contributions to open-source projects, even small ones.
Exposure to rich-text editor frameworks (ProseMirror, CodeMirror, Lexical, Tiptap).
Familiarity with Service Workers, IndexedDB, or offline-first app patterns.
Experience with Electron or desktop app packaging.
Prior experience on project management, productivity, or collaboration products.
Our Tech Stack
Frontend
React with TailwindCSS, using hooks for composable functionality
React Router for client-side routing
MobX for binding the data model to the UI
ProseMirror-based content editor
Electron for the desktop application
Backend & Infrastructure
Django/Python, Golang, and Elixir services
PostgreSQL and Redis
Public REST and GraphQL APIs with full access to user data
AWS Cloud with Kubernetes and Rancher
Tooling & Monitoring
Internal design system with a React component library
Vite and Rolldown for build tooling
DataDog and Sentry for observability
GitHub, Slack, Plane, Figma, and Whimsical for day-to-day work
Why Join Plane
Accelerate your growth. Work alongside senior engineers who genuinely enjoy mentoring and will invest in your development. Code reviews, pairing sessions, and architecture discussions are real learning moments here, not formalities.
Ship work that matters. The features you build will be used by thousands of teams globally. You'll see the impact of your work in production within weeks of joining — not after months of onboarding.
Learn the full stack of modern frontend. From local-first sync to real-time collaboration to performance at scale, Plane touches nearly every interesting problem in modern frontend engineering. It's a fast way to grow from "I can build features" to "I can design systems."
Build in the open. Everything you ship lands in an open-source codebase. Your GitHub contribution graph will reflect the real work you're doing — visible to the community and useful for your career.
A culture of craft and kindness. We write things down, review each other's work carefully, and treat questions — especially from new engineers — as a healthy sign of engagement.
Room to grow into more. As you mature in the role, you'll naturally take on bigger surfaces, more design input, and more ownership. We hire junior engineers expecting them to become senior engineers here.

description_text:

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

What makes us a great place to work
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Job Summary
We are hiring a Software Engineer to solve real business problems for the functions that keep Bain running. From Finance to Legal, HR, Risk, and more you will build full-stack software, AI agents, integrations, and workflow products that turn messy, ambiguous business needs into reliable, working software. You will partner closely with the people who use what you ship ensuring it is correct, reliable, maintainable, and clearly communicated.
This role suits high-initiative builders with strong software fundamentals who treat AI as a force multiplier - using it not only to deliver more, but to deliver faster, more efficiently, and to a higher standard.
What Makes This Role Different
You will work on real business problems with users close enough to give fast feedback.
You will use AI development tools as part of the normal engineering workflow, not as a side experiment.
You will be encouraged to compress the path from idea to working software without lowering the engineering bar.
You will build across the stack: frontend, backend, data, APIs, integrations, and agentic workflows.
You will be expected to ship quickly while still writing code that another engineer can understand, test, and extend.
You will learn across domains instead of specializing only in one platform or one automation tool.
What You Will Build
Internal tools that turn messy business processes into structured, trackable workflows.
AI agents that draft, check, route, summarize, or monitor work with appropriate human review.
Full-stack applications for Bain teams that need reliable software, not one-off scripts.
Integrations across documents, tickets, databases, collaboration tools, and internal platforms.
Prototypes that move quickly and can be hardened into maintainable production systems when the value is proven.
Principal Accountabilities and % of time
Build full-stack solutions (45%)
Own contained projects and features from problem clarification through launch. Build backend services, frontend interfaces, data models, APIs, integrations, and workflow logic that solve practical business problems.


Use AI to accelerate delivery (20%) 
Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Replit, or similar tools to plan, code, test, debug, document, and refactor. Validate AI output before it reaches users.


Translate business ambiguity into software (15%) 
Clarify user needs, prioritize MVP features, ask probing questions, and choose practical technical approaches. Partner with senior engineers on broader architecture, security, and production-readiness decisions.


Maintain quality and reliability (15%) 
Write readable, modular code; add useful tests; debug issues across the stack; document important decisions; and support solutions after launch.


Collaborate and learn(5%) 
Work with business stakeholders, product owners, senior engineers, and other technology teams. Share reusable prompts, patterns, components, and lessons learned.
What Good Looks Like
You can break down a broad business problem, define the first useful solution, and deliver a working result.
You use AI tools fluently but do not outsource judgment to them.
You can explain your code, debug it, test it, and improve it after feedback.
You communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and business users.
You recognize when to keep a solution simple and when to ask for senior engineering guidance.


Qualifications 
Experience
We are looking for someone who has:
3-5 years of professional software development experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
A track record of shipping working software, whether in production roles, substantial internships, or serious personal projects.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of a real engineering workflow, or clear evidence of adopting them quickly and responsibly.
Comfort working through ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and communicating clearly with both engineers and business users.


Required: 
Strong coding fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, debugging, testing, and basic software design.
Working ability in at least one general-purpose programming language used for production software, ideally Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
Familiarity with SQL, relational data modeling, web applications, REST APIs, Git, pull requests, and code review.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools, or clear evidence that you can adopt them quickly and responsibly.
Ability to work through ambiguity, ask good questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and communicate clearly.


Preferred:
Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Svelte, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, or cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Experience integrating with enterprise systems and APIs such as Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, or Teams.
Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, evals, prompt versioning, guardrails, memory, and human approval flows.
Experience building internal tools, workflow products, business process software, or AI-enabled applications.
Exposure to Power Platform, RPA tools, n8n, Zapier, or Make is helpful but not required.

DESCRIPTION
The Business Analyst role family focuses on using data analysis and business knowledge to solve problems and drive decisions. 

Key job responsibilities
You use data and your understanding of business objectives to solve straightforward problems to drive decision(s) and action(s) within a workflow. You analyze straightforward or previously-defined business and/or data processes to drive improvement. Your work is tactical, where you take actions to achieve a defined goal. Those actions require you to set success measurements and priorities and engage with others in a team as necessary to deliver. 
The problems you solve are well-defined by a combination of stakeholder requests, business requirements, and direction from your manager and your team. The tasks you work on involve well-defined subject areas with clear requirements, deliverables, and timelines. You use your knowledge and skills to build, implement, and/or meet assigned goals. Your work is reviewed periodically. As your solutions may need refinement, you solicit guidance from your manager or your team to deliver results that meet relevant requirements and timelines.
You know your team’s business objectives and use your domain knowledge to provide analytics solutions. You understand how the domain you support relates to the broader business. You extract readily available data and apply basic transformations (e.g., applying if-then logic, aggregating data at different intervals, calculating metric ratios) and analysis in spreadsheets, SQL, and other relevant tools to solve problems. You use descriptive analysis (e.g., pivots, groupings of metrics by attributes, creation of process flows) to understand impact and identify drivers. You ask questions to clarify requirements and determine if and when a new solution is required. You make tradeoffs between time and resources. 
You recognize similar problems and apply existing solutions to solve them faster. When a problem requires building a net-new solution, you use existing assets and knowledge of what exists within your team to avoid duplication. You assess your work for quality and accuracy, validating against existing sources of truth.
Your analytics solutions generate findings that are inputs to your team or stakeholders and help solve straightforward problems. You provide descriptive analyses to support team metrics. Your work informs decisions by providing visibility to business performance, highlighting anomalies and systemic outliers, or revealing new opportunities. You help to improve scalability in your team through documentation, accessibility, and replicability. You automate manual, repetitive work. 
You document your analytical approach including metric definitions, applied logic, assumptions, and sources. You make data and findings easily accessible to your team through documentation highlighting analytical approach (e.g., business problem, metric definitions, applied logic, assumptions, data sources). Your analytics solutions are consumable by your customers and replicable by other analysts and engineers, helping to make similar work simpler in the future. You help train new peers.
You share findings with your team or stakeholders through written and verbal communication channels. You are learning to be clear and concise in your communication. When communicating, you consider the business context and audience and tailor appropriately. Your work may also be shared through mechanisms owned by others, such as WBR callouts, email flashes, and/or documents. While you may not own these communications end-to-end, you are an important part of their creation. You manage meetings effectively. You are learning to put the right people in the room. You are trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above your level (L7). You are learning to communicate across an increasing diversity of locales and roles.
You seek and/or support representation and equity for marginalized voices within organizational systems, assessing barriers to authentic contribution or participation. You demonstrate a willingness to challenge the status quo. You are learning to build products and services to benefit those on the margins and minimizing the ways products and services may perpetuate inequity.

Take full ownership of client presentations and reports, creating impactful visualizations with professional polish and meticulous attention to detail 
Own data validation and quality assurance processes for key production datasets, proactively identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions 
Collaborate directly with data source owners, system, and process owners to identify and resolve limitations or friction points that impact planning support effectiveness 
Support regional planners with any data, insights and ad hoc requests. Leverage best practice to ensure rapid delivery and maintain high data quality 
Proactively identify and eliminate repetitive manual processes through automation or smarter tooling — building for long-term scalability 
Implement best practices for knowledge transfer and documentation to achieve internal consistency and long-term scalability 
Mentor and support junior analysts by providing guidance and promoting a culture of continuous learning and development 

Minimum Requirements:
Strong analytical skills and an abundance of intellectual curiosity 
Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative field 
5+ years data-focused experience: Professional experience in data-focused role with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel/Google Sheets 
Proficient in SQL (any dialect) 
Expertise with spreadsheet-based tools like Google Sheets or Excel 
High-agency, self-starter mindset proactively identifying problems and driving solutions with strong ownership and bias toward action, even under deadline pressure 
Exceptional communication skills: able to translate complex data findings into polished, visually compelling, executive-ready narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
Demonstrated experience with data validation and quality assurance methodologies. 
Excellent attention to detail, exhibiting the highest standards of professional integrity and work ethic 
Cultural sensitivity and flexibility in working hours to collaborate with a global team 
Experience and comfort working remotely, with the ability to thrive under minimal supervision 

Preferred Qualifications:
Corporate Real Estate knowledge 
Familiarity with or eagerness to learn Google Cloud Platform (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage, App Engine): enthusiasm for continuous technical upskilling valued. 
Proficiency in or strong interest in developing Python skills for analytics and automation 
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! 

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: 

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. 

About JLL – 

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. 

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally. 

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

About the Role
Jolly Clamps Pvt. Ltd. (JCPL) is building in-house capability to automate its manufacturing operations and bring its inventory, work-in-progress (WIP) and costing data under tight, reliable control. This is a hands-on role for someone in their career who wants to excel in how a real manufacturing business runs and turn its day-to-day data into dependable dashboards, reports and small applications.
You will work closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the operations and information technology (IT) teams, and the shop floor across both the Goregaon head office and the Virar factory. Full training and mentoring will be provided; what matters most is a genuine appetite to learn, attention to detail, and comfort working with data.
Core principles you will be trained to follow:
rely on a single, agreed source of data rather than scattered reports;
use clear, deterministic (rule-based) computation that anyone can audit, with no guesswork;
always validate a solution on one test case before scaling it across the plant.
Key Responsibilities
Under the guidance of the CFO and senior team members, you will support, build and maintain the following. You are not expected to do all of this on day one — you will be brought up to speed project by project.
Production Planning & Control (PPC) — Python-based Planning Solutions
A central part of the role is helping build and run a suite of Python-based tools that turn the monthly Sales forecast into a realistic, committed production plan. Working with the planning and operations teams, you will support:
Planning engine (demand to commitment): Build and maintain the monthly planning engine that converts the Sales forecast (received item-wise and family-wise from the enterprise resource planning system) into a deliverable commitment, running demand against line capacity, manpower and material limits to produce the family-wise quantity committed to Sales.
Forecast cleanup & common-part master: Automate cleanup and filtration of the location-wise forecast by grouping stock-keeping units (SKUs) that share a common internal part code into a single common part, replacing the manual pivot; create and maintain the master that maps customer and location SKUs to the common-part code.
Capacity, manpower & occupancy model: Automate the family-wise line-capacity and manpower model to compute shift-wise occupancy percentage, flag demand exceeding both shifts as over-capacity, and base commitments on current manpower, allowing for the recruitment lead time.
Economic batch quantity batching: Hold the economic batch quantity (EBQ) per item as a clean master and build batching logic that defaults to it, quantifying the efficiency loss when priority orders break the batch and trigger extra changeovers.
Make-to-stock stock-level prioritisation: Automate the colour-coded make-to-stock , stock-level sheet and auto-sequence production so the most critical parts are made first, replacing the heavy manual spreadsheet.
Trading-conversion & excess-production traceability: Build logic that traces production booked against a common part, the trading-conversion transfers to individual customer codes and the residual balance, so excess production is attributed to the Sales order that drove it and made visible to Sales.
Demand cadence by customer type: Encode the differing demand cadences by customer type (aftermarket weekly; regular original-equipment-manufacturer customers on a weekly cycle; trigger-based customers daily) into the plan, along with the buffer and overtime catch-up mechanism used to meet the required daily rate.
Material requirement planning: Extend the planning engine to derive raw-material and child-part requirements from the committed family and item plan and batch quantities, so procurement is driven by the confirmed plan and checked against stock and open purchase orders.
Data Reconciliation & Control Reports (rule-based, auditable)
Daily inventory reconciliation reports (opening stock plus purchases, less consumption, equals closing stock; and finished goods produced versus dispatched).
Material-balance checks that reconcile input against output, scrap and work-in-progress (WIP) movement, allowing for normal process weight and measurement tolerances.
Consumption-based costing reports that value material on actual usage rather than purchases, organised by cost centre.
Reclassification of items between make-to-stock and make-to-order based on demand trends.
Exception and error-tracking reports that flag wrong, reversed, delayed or duplicate transactions, along with their likely cause.
Threshold-based monitoring (for example, inventory or work-in-progress above an agreed reference level) with automatic alert notifications.
Workflow Automation
Help set up the scheduled extraction of system reports, with automatic pickup and processing into daily reconciliations.
Support automated report extraction through application programming interfaces (API) feeding business intelligence (BI) dashboards.
Assist in consolidating overlapping automation tools onto a single, governed workflow platform.
Data-Capture Applications & Dashboards
Support data-capture applications that record activity at source (plan versus actual, productivity, adherence), with a database behind them and a link to the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
Help deploy point-of-source data capture using fixed screens or tablets feeding a central database and live dashboards.
System Controls (with the IT team)
Help implement controls that prevent item, grade or master-data mismatch, with daily exception reporting.
Support duplicate-entry prevention using unique transaction identifiers and a holding area for failed entries.
Assist in evaluating a warehouse management system (WMS) and its integration with the ERP.
General
Validate every report and tool against real data before it is relied upon.
Document what you build so others can understand and maintain it.
Coordinate with stores, shop-floor, accounts and IT colleagues to keep data accurate and on time.
Skills & Knowledge
Essential (foundational level is acceptable for a fresher)
Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java : Working knowledge of Python,N8N,Replit,Cursor,Java for data handling, building planning and reconciliation logic, and simple automation.
Data / spreadsheets: Comfort with spreadsheets, formulas and structured data; willingness to learn Power Query and business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI.
Databases: Basic understanding of databases and the ability to write simple structured query language (SQL) queries.
Logic & accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a logical, methodical approach to problem-solving.
Communication: Clear written and spoken communication, able to explain a number or a report simply.

Programming: Basic Java or any second programming language.
Domain interest: Curiosity about manufacturing, production planning, inventory, costing and operations.

Graduates with relevant projects, internships or self-built work (for example, dashboards, small applications or automations) are encouraged to apply.

title: Business Analyst-Data Insights, Translation Services Operations
description_text:
DESCRIPTION
Are you passionate about transforming operational processes through data-driven insights? Are you motivated to have a direct impact on customers around the world? Do you have a business analytics background and love for continuous improvement and finding creative solutions to challenging problems? Amazon's Translation Services team is responsible for providing translation tools and solutions to support the localization and translation needs of all Amazon businesses. At Translation Services Operations, we partner with other internal Amazonian teams to translate and deliver content for users of Amazon's tools and services around the world. We obsess over finding the optimal balance between quality, speed, and cost for customers we serve.
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to own end-to-end analytical work for our centralized metrics and reporting function — from understanding complex data dependencies to delivering actionable insights that drive business decisions. You will own problems from start to finish: partnering with business teams to understand their needs, building the reports and tools that surface meaningful patterns, and explaining the "why" behind the numbers. You will build dashboards, create new metrics, develop analytical frameworks, and leverage existing data sources to keep stakeholders informed and empowered. You will be comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate.

Key job responsibilities
Own and develop key operational metrics end-to-end — from understanding data sources and dependencies, to designing metric logic, building reporting solutions, and delivering insights that drive action
Partner hands-on with business teams (Operations, Quality, Business Development, Customer Success) to understand their data needs, translate them into structured analytical approaches, and deliver reporting that enables informed decision-making
Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth for organizational performance
Dive deep into data to identify patterns, trends, and root causes — then clearly communicate the "what," the "so what," and the "now what" to stakeholders and leadership
Proactively identify opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) to optimize data insights generation, automate reporting workflows, and surface patterns at scale
Create new metrics, implement new measurement logics, and develop analytical tools that evolve with the business — ensuring our reporting capabilities stay ahead of organizational needs
Conduct root cause analyses on performance variations and develop scalable frameworks to monitor, explain, and improve business outcomes

A day in the life
In the morning, you'll review performance dashboards ahead of a business review, identifying any anomalies or trends that need attention — preparing clear narratives around the data to share with leadership. Mid-morning, you'll partner with an operations team to understand a new reporting need, mapping out data dependencies and designing the logic for a new metric they've requested — collaborating with data engineering teams to ensure the right data is available. After lunch, you'll dive into a dataset to investigate why a key performance indicator shifted month-over-month, slicing the data across multiple dimensions to isolate the driver and document your findings. Later, you'll work on building an automated reporting solution that replaces a manual process, leveraging AI capabilities to surface insights that would otherwise require hours of manual analysis. Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate stakeholder requests with longer-term projects that strengthen the organization's data foundation.

About the team
The Vendor Management & Data Insights (VMDI) team, within Translation Services Operations, consolidates vendor management operations with centralized reporting functions — including invoicing, pricing, and metrics — under one leadership. We are responsible for providing the data foundation that drives decision-making across the organization, while building and maintaining excellent relationships with external vendors to deliver results at scale for our customers. We collaborate closely with Quality and Content, Business Development, Customer Success, and Products teams to provide a seamless experience for both vendors and clients. We value a collaborative, inclusive, innovative, and data-driven culture as we work to optimize processes, improve quality, and drive cost efficiencies across Amazon's translation ecosystem.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
Knowledge of databases (querying and analyzing) such as SQL, MYSQL, and ETL Manager and working with large data sets
Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience using Python or R for data analysis or statistical tools such as SAS
Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
Comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate

description_text:
Introduction
Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right.
We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive.
At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. 
Founded in 2006, the Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) upholds the values of quality, innovation, and teamwork. With 10,000+ professionals across five India locations, GCoE is where knowledge-driven individuals make a significant impact and build rewarding, long-term careers.

Overview

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking to hire a Data Analytics professional for the GCoE Business Enablement vertical. 
You will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to provide actionable insights that drive business decisions. 
You will manage the collection, processing, and analysis of data to support strategic initiatives and improve operational efficiency. 
We are looking for someone who is very strong in MS Excel and Access, possesses good communication skills, and has a keen attention to detail. 
Exposure to advanced analytics tools, data visualization techniques, and predictive modeling is a definite plus. 
Your role will involve driving data excellence and innovation. 
Additionally, you will be responsible for fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the analytics team. 
You will interact with team members located in various regions across the globe.
This position offers an exciting opportunity to fast track your learning and to build understanding of a wide range of sectors, at pace and with lots of variety. 
Working alongside highly experienced reward consultants, the role offers much greater opportunities for rich and diverse learning and professional development than is available in most in-house roles, equipping you for the future while also honing your client engagement skills.

How you'll make an impact

Responsibilities:

Research and Analysis:
Researching data sources, market practice and other benchmarking information from published salary surveys through to internet searches.
Data analysis (primarily Excel based), including interpreting results and developing recommendations across pay benchmarking, gender pay gap reporting and equal pay auditing.
Data insight – translating data into valued findings and understandable information, which is accessible and useful to clients.
Effective presentation of findings - formatting data into clear, accessible graphs, tables and infographics.

Development and Design:
Providing input and evidence based advice in the development of pay progression systems and pay structures.
Cost modelling of different scenarios and similar impact assessments
Drafting documents in Excel, Word or PowerPoint to present options and recommendations to 
clients.

Survey Management:
Gallagher runs a high quality UK benefits survey, which is published annually in October (250 participant organisations submitted data in 2019) and the job holder plays an important role in shaping design and continuous improvement of the survey, as well as encouraging participation.
Survey co-ordination – receiving, cleansing and checking inbound data and referring queries back to clients
Survey analyses - establishing findings, trend data and other insights and thereafter working with colleagues in Gallagher Communications to present those findings in a visual and impactful manner.
Survey development – helping design new surveys as well as supporting the growth of existing surveys.
Analysis of our annual Employee Communication Survey for Global Communication.
Supporting the build and analysis of employee communication survey.

Client Interaction:
Although the role will be primarily office based, there will be opportunities to attend client meetings,typically accompanied by a Senior Consultant, to: 
Take the brief for a client or prospect’s consultancy requirements
Obtain the views of key stakeholders within the organisation e.g. in running focus groups 
Writing or helping with the preparation of proposals for client work (either following a preliminary meeting or telephone and email contact with the client or in response to an invitation to tender)
Managing small benchmarking projects alone, albeit drawing on the close support of Consultants and Senior Consultants, as required. 
Most small projects will be for new or existing clients and usually confined to telephone and/or email based contact with the client.

Reward Consulting team:
Supporting with Gender Pay Gap analysis and reporting for clients - this ranges from basic reports to deep dive analysis
Support with Pay Transparency projects which will also need some analytical support
Setting up spreadsheets for pay benchmarking and pay structures projects
Creating client facing calculation tools for variable pay projects
Analysis of the annual National Benchmarking Survey for the UK

EVP team:
Data Collection & Integration - Aggregate and clean data from multiple sources (HRIS, engagement surveys, compensation databases, external benchmarks).
Analytics & Modelling – Build/Review statistical models (e.g., regression, attrition prediction) to identify drivers of promotions, exits, and engagement ; Develop/review dashboards in tools like Power BI for real-time insights on attraction, retention, and workforce segmentation. 
Reporting & Visualisation - Create clear, compelling reports and visualisations, including persona-based insights and EVP impact metrics.

Competencies:

Analytical Thinking: Ability to systematically and logically break down complex data sets to extract 
actionable insights and inform business decisions.

Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy and thoroughness in reviewing data submissions, 
identifying discrepancies, and maintaining organized records

Communication Skills: Proficient in conveying information clearly and effectively to clients and team 
members, ensuring mutual understanding and timely data

Technical Proficiency: Expertise in using MS Excel and Access for data entry, analysis, and database 
management, with a willingness to learn additional analytics tools

Problem-Solving: Capability to identify issues within data sets and implement effective solutions 
to resolve discrepancies and improve data processes.

Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with team members and departments to achieve 
common goals and ensure seamless data management

Process Improvement: Aptitude for identifying opportunities to enhance data accuracy and efficiency 
and implementing innovative solutions.

Adaptability: Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and new challenges in a dynamic 
work environment.

Organizational Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, maintaining organized 
and up-to-date records and documentation.


About you

Qualifications:

Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Preferred Degree: Master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees can provide deeper expertise and a competitive edge in the field.

Certificate(s)/Special Training:

Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): A widely recognized certification that demonstrates expertise in the analytics process.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, EU Prime and Marketing Analytics & Science (PRIMAS)
description_text:
DESCRIPTION
Are you passionate about giving customers the richest, most inspiring experience in their shopping journey? Do you like to dive deep to understand how customer-centric solutions drive measurable results? Do you enjoy working closely with the business, scientists and software engineers to build scalable products? You are in the right place! Come join our Prime & Marketing Analytics and Science (PRIMAS) team, where your actions will have direct impact to millions of customers!

The EU Marketing & Prime organization is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer. This role combines large-scale analytics with statistical and data-science work — causal inference, experimentation, and predictive modeling. If your background is in data science, applied statistics, or quantitative analytics, this is that work under Amazon's internal job title.

The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities and lifetime value. We use the latest data science tools and advanced analytical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors and generate actionable insights on where, when and how we provide products and programs to our customers to meet their needs and to delight them. We help to increase customer engagement, sales and marketing efficiency. Our systems are built entirely in-house and on automated large-scale analytics systems. You will generate insights, design/deliver/measure experiments and strategies across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior and engagement, design and conduct rigorous experiments on the effectiveness and efficiency of different marketing actions, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing. You will work on the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest problems in the industry alongside some of the best scientists, statisticians, and software engineers in the field.

Key job responsibilities
Working on complex, loosely defined analytics problems and defining the team's Business Intelligence (BI) strategy — delivering independently and influencing the organization's BI architecture.
- Providing analytics solutions for complex business problems; building analyses and solutions that are robust, extensible and scalable; communicating effectively with management audiences (narratives, inputs into Business Reviews); refining BI strategies that cross teams and making technical trade-offs for long- and short-term needs.
Designing and implementing technical solutions with an appropriate analytics strategy and data set design; understanding system limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and the reasons for technical decisions.

Building and evaluating causal and treatment-effect models that produce conversion and valuation signals consumed by downstream bidding and budgeting systems.
Designing and running experiments and quasi-experiments (A/B, geo, holdout) to measure marketing incrementality, and developing measurement frameworks that quantify the true, platform-independent contribution of marketing over time.
- Working with first- and third-party data to identify and target high-opportunity customer segments where standard platform optimization falls short.
Providing analyses, frameworks and solutions that inform multiple teams' business decisions and highlight new opportunities.
Driving best practices in operational excellence, data modelling, and analysis.

Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Experience in the data/BI space
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Datavail is seeking a highly skilled Data Governance Analyst to aid in working with our clients to define and develop Data Governance solutions that meet defined business objectives. The individual should have experience in defining and developing solutions around Governance and Data Governance to help define and identify solutions for our client's business problems. The Data Governance Analyst will be responsible for conceptualizing and defining end to end solutions in areas around the use and implementation of Data Governance frameworks and concepts including areas such as Metadata Management, Data Access and Security Governance, Data Stewardship and Operating models, Data Quality Idenification, Root Cause Analysis and Solutioning, and other related areas.

Deep understanding of DAMA_DMBoK, DCAM, and ISO/IEC 38505. 
Have experience in creating and implementing policies, standards, and controls for enterprise data. 
Metadata Management 
Proficient in Business, technical, and operational metadata. 
Experience with glossaries, catalogs, lineage, and stewardship models including Sensitive data classification and handling. 
Data Access & Security Governance: 
Understands and can define Role_based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC).

Knows regulatory compliance such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, SOX, PCI, and emerging AI/data regulations and is able to apply to policies, monitoring, risk assessment and scoring. 
Has experience in conducting data risk assessments and remediation planning.

Designing centralized, federated, or hybrid governance models. 
Enabling stewardship roles and workflows, being able to align data governance practices to business value and developing use cases for deployment of governance processes including defining data ownership and identifying data owners as well as data stewardship and data stewards. 
Has experience in establishing steering committees, RACI matrix for governance and cadence for on-going governance program. 
AI Governance Literacy & Competency 
AI Risk & Compliance 
Understanding of emerging regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). 
Ability to assess AI/ML models for fairness, bias, transparency, and safety.

Knowledge of ethical AI frameworks, transparency requirements, and accountability structures. 
Creating policy guardrails for model development and deployment.

Candidates should have played a lead role in the solutioning, design, and implementation of these solutions and acted in a project leadership role in these engagements. Good Communication skills are required as well as experience leading engagements. Experience in performing assessments and defining Analytics solutions is also required. 
Datavail is one of the largest data focused services company in North America and provides both professional and managed services and expertise in Database Management, Application Development and Management, Cloud & Infrastructure Management, Packaged Applications and BI/Analytics. 

What You will DO at Datavail: 

Advise, own, define, and articulate a strategic technical vision to drive solutions in the Analytics space for our prospect and customers 
Be the Go-To "trusted advisor" for our customers 
Work with our prospects and customers to define and architect joint initiatives and co-create their transformation journeys and roadmaps to meet their business and IT needs. 
Be a leader and give delivery teams context and confidence to make correct technical decisions, while establishing culture of excellence 
Provide strategic leadership on cross-practice customer engagements for Datavail's key customers 
Advise customers on overall technology standards and practices and governance strategies 
Keep abreast of new trends and best practices in the technology landscape 
Provide market insights to ensure our customer's IT strategy stays current and contributes to their competitive advantage 
Take the initiative in thought leadership, innovation, and creativity 
Implement and lead the implementation of Data Governance solutions for both on-prem and in the cloud data management solutions. 
Collaborate with Cloud Solution Architects within Datavail in developing complex end-to-end solutions. 
Maintain technical skills and knowledge, collaborate and share with the technical community while educate customers on Data Governance. 
Present and lead ideation and solution alignment workshops with our customers to establish the art of the possible and help them to realize it 
Provide thought leadership by speaking in technical conferences, webinars, marketing events and heavily involved in publishing case studies, white papers and blogs. 

Who are we LOOKING for: 
You are an experienced technology architect with strong business acumen. You are as comfortable working with a technical team as you are with client business leaders (C-Suite and down) and you know how to build bridges between the two. With your excellent communications skills, you are adept at mapping business needs to technology solutions and helping non-technical audiences understand the benefits of these solutions. 

What will you BRING to Datavail: 
5 to 10 or more years of hands on experience delivering projects 
5+ years of overall consulting experience 
Demonstrated ability to lead and architect complex engagements 
Excellent understanding and hands-on experience in architecting and delivering Data Governance in Analytical solutions with focus with both on-prem and cloud technologies (both support and new application development) 
Hands-on capability to work with the development team 
Experience with various Data Governance toolsets 
Strong collaborator with successful track record of working in a heavily matrix organizational structure

Exceptional consulting skills in communicating, establishing of strategic direction, influencing others, negotiating skills, operational decision making, problem solving, facilitating and managing meetings, and questioning and probing.

The Senior Data Engineer will work closely with BI analysts, data product owners, data architects, governance teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that analytics teams have access to accurate, well-modeled, reusable, and high-performing data assets.
The role will primarily support the enterprise Databricks platform on AWS, while also working with or migrating from legacy Amazon Redshift assets where applicable. The successful candidate should be comfortable engineering data pipelines, preparing curated datasets, designing reusable reporting models, improving data quality, and enabling BI teams to deliver dashboards more quickly and consistently.
This role also includes informal leadership responsibilities, including coaching junior engineers or analysts, supporting code reviews, sharing development best practices, and helping establish consistent data engineering patterns for BI delivery

Databricks Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

Develop reliable ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, validate, and publish data from multiple sources using advanced SQL, Python, and PySpark.

BI Data Products & Curated Dataset Development

Partner with BI teams to translate reporting requirements, KPIs, and business logic into scalable data solutions.
Design business-ready datasets that enable executive reporting, operational analytics, commercial scorecards, and self-service BI.
Create reusable data products that accelerate BI delivery and ensure accurate reporting outcomes.
Data Modeling & Reporting Layer Enablement

Translate business requirements into scalable data structures supporting KPI tracking, trend analysis, drill-down reporting, and self-service analytics.
Collaborate with BI developers to optimize data models for performance, usability, consistency, and maintainability.

Apply advanced proficiency in US pharmaceutical commercial data sources — including patient-level claims, EMR, specialty pharmacy, and sales data — and analytics tools to generate decision-ready insights with clear business implications.
Design and execute patient journey analyses, HCP segmentation models, performance deep-dives, and competitive assessments that provide actionable, evidence-based recommendations to US I&A brand leads and commercial partners.
Serve as an emerging analytical thought leader within the GCC team — contributing to methodology development, analytical best practices, and the informal mentoring of Analyst colleagues.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
Brand Analytics and Insight Generation
Own end-to-end delivery of assigned performance analytics workstreams, producing reports and dashboards that track brand KPIs — including patient shares, new starts, source of business, adherence, and HCP engagement — at national and subnational levels.
Integrate and analyze diverse US commercial data sources — including real-world data (claims, EMR), specialty pharmacy data, sales data, and channel data — to generate comprehensive patient and HCP insights that support brand strategy and launch readiness.
Develop and maintain business rules for processing raw patient-level data, leveraging a deep understanding of data nuances, commercial context, and market knowledge to ensure analytical accuracy and consistency.
Lead custom reporting and complex ad hoc analysis requests with independent hypothesis formulation, rigorous methodology, and well-documented, insight-rich outputs.
Data Visualization and Reporting Excellence
Design and maintain Tableau or Power BI dashboards and reporting tools that clearly communicate brand performance trends, patient funnel dynamics, and field force activity to US stakeholders.
Establish KPIs and metrics — including patient shares, duration of therapy (DoT), adherence rates, source of business, and campaign effectiveness — and monitor their performance across national and subnational geographies and payer channel types.
Proactively identify opportunities to automate and scale recurring reporting workflows using SQL, Python, or Databricks, reducing manual effort and improving analytical reproducibility.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication
Partner with GCC Managers and US I&A brand leads to clarify analytical requirements, align on deliverable scope, and communicate progress proactively.
Synthesize findings from multiple data sources into cohesive, decision-oriented analytical stories with clear "so what" implications and actionable recommendations tailored to US brand and commercial audiences.
Provide informal mentoring and quality guidance to Analyst I and Analyst II colleagues, reviewing their outputs, explaining methodological choices, and supporting their professional development.
Contribute to team knowledge management by documenting analytical methods, data source guides, and reusable query libraries.

3-4 years of experience in US pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare analytics, with demonstrated independent ownership of analytical deliverables.
Deep working knowledge of US pharma commercial datasets: patient-level claims (IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health), specialty pharmacy (867), EMR, and sales data is required.

## About Threads Uniform Agency & The Role
Threads Uniform Agency is seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer for a critical, end-to-end cloud modernization engagement.
In this role, you will lead the migration of our legacy, single-server e-commerce stack into a modern, secure, and PCI-compliant Azure environment. The current setup runs NopCommerce, SQL Server, IIS, and SFTP bundled on a single legacy AWS EC2 instance. You will be responsible for unbundling this monolith into highly available, separated compute, database, and file-transfer tiers.
Threads Uniform Agency already has a sketched target architecture in place. You will not be starting from a blank page; instead, you will validate, refine, and execute this vision. This is a high-ownership, independent role covering infrastructure architecture, hands-on Azure provisioning, and building critical data pipelines from our on-premises SQL layer (fed by a SaaS ERP) into a cloud data lake. You will work closely with our client-side IT Director and a separate offshore vendor handling the parallel e-commerce platform upgrade.
## Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Azure Provisioning: Validate and refine the sketched target architecture; hands-on provisioning of VNets, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and IAM/RBAC using Infrastructure-as-Code.
Monolith Unbundling: Deconstruct the existing single-server setup into dedicated, secure, and scalable cloud tiers.
Data Pipeline Engineering: Build robust batch ETL pipelines (full + incremental loads) using Azure Data Factory to move data from SQL Server sources into a cloud data lake.
Security & PCI Compliance: Establish and document a PCI DSS-compliant baseline, ensuring robust network segmentation, access controls, and strict encryption at rest and in transit.
Integration Mapping: Map and validate integration points with third-party SaaS solutions (ERP-as-SaaS, tax services, payment processors, and EDI/punch-out connectors).
Documentation: Maintain strict documentation discipline, delivering Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), operational runbooks, and a phased migration roadmap.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as an independent expert, reviewing third-party vendor proposals and translating technical tradeoffs clearly during weekly syncs with the IT Director.
## Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure core services (VNet, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, IAM/RBAC).
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proven expertise using Terraform or ARM/Bicep.
Data Integration: Solid experience with Azure Data Factory (or equivalent ETL/orchestration tools) building pipelines from SQL Server.
Database Expertise: Strong SQL Server background with the ability to reverse-engineer and document existing schemas.
Scripting: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to migrate and adapt legacy automation workflows.
Compliance: Direct exposure to PCI DSS requirements and compliance documentation.
Independence: Proven track record of working successfully as a solo engineer on a project without a secondary backup resource.

Familiarity with third-party cloud monitoring/observability tools (e.g., DataDog).
Experience with managed file transfer/SFTP gateway products (e.g., Couchdrop, GoAnywhere, JSCAPE).

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 
Must have skills : Spring Boot
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Custom Software Engineer, you will engage in the development of custom software solutions that involve designing, coding, and enhancing various components across systems or applications. Your typical day will include collaborating with team members to utilize modern frameworks and agile practices, ensuring the delivery of scalable and high-performing solutions that are tailored to meet specific business needs. You will also be involved in troubleshooting and optimizing existing software components to improve functionality and performance, while continuously seeking opportunities for innovation and improvement in the software development process.

Support team in debugging test bench issues or inconsistencies in results

Professional & Technical Skills:
Proficient in Java (Object-Oriented Programming, Collections, File I/O, etc.)
Java with Spring Boot having Microservices Background.
Familiarity with Apache Flink/Apache Kafka/Azure Eventhubs, AKS/EKS, Docker/Kubernetes, Datadog/Grafana/Prometheus/Splunk, Terraform
Familiarity with dependency injection, annotations, configuration properties, and Spring test utilities.
Practical experience with Spring Framework for building and structuring automation components.
Experience in developing test automation and REST API validation using Java.
Strong hands-on experience in Java (8 or above), with good knowledge of OOP principles, exception handling, multithreading, and collections framework.
Proficient in writing unit tests using JUnit and mocking frameworks like Mockito.
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols or embedded systems testing is a plus.
Familiarity with version control tools like Git/ GitLab
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.
Attention to detail and ownership of assigned modules.
Exposure to ET Framework or other proprietary test frameworks.
Understanding of TCU or connected vehicle technologies.
Automotive domain experience.

Additional Information:
The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

15 years full time education

title: Application Software Engineer
description_text:
Adheres to all phases of the application software development lifecycle. Applies working knowledge to develop and review code for application features and enhancements following design specifications, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix simple and moderately complex application issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Troubleshoots and resolves standard and non-standard issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Collaborates with own team and begins to network outside of the team to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues, with limited supervision. Begins to collaborate with the team to establish and follow application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality. Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), with limited guidance. 
Key Responsibilities 
Application Software Development: 
Delivers small-to-medium features end-to-end within a single application. 
Provides production support during business hours; participates in incident rotations with guidance. 
Troubleshoots routine and some non-routine issues across app services and straightforward OCI/integration paths. 
Coordinates with QA/engineering on test coverage and release readiness. 
Applies architectural guidelines; raises design questions when needed. 
Breaks down requirements into maintainable modules and tests. 
Integrates and documents API dependencies for assigned features. 
Contributes input to team-level build priorities based on reliability/scalability needs. 
References forums/live-site reports to improve acceptance criteria. 
Collaborates with Designers/PMs/engineers to clarify requirements.

Broccoli is building the AI operating system for home service businesses, an $800B+ market.
We work with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors — the people who keep homes running — and we replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with AI agents that actually do the work.
Our AI assistants answer phones, book jobs, follow up with customers, and drive revenue — fully integrated into CRM systems like ServiceTitan.

Build end-to-end features across backend and frontend that directly impact customer revenue

4-7 years of experience building and shipping products

Curiosity for how real businesses operate, not just how software works
Ability to move fast without breaking things that matter

description_text:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 
Must have skills : Data Analytics
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Roles and Responsibilities 
Design and build multi-page, interactive Power BI dashboards featuring drill throughs, bookmarks, custom visuals, and role-based filters to deliver tailored, actionable insights for diverse business users.
Develop complex DAX measures, calculated tables, and time-intelligence functions to support dynamic KPI reporting and scenario modeling directly within the Power BI data model.
Leverage Power Query (M-Query) to perform advanced data transformations—such as unpivoting, merging, conditional logic, and parameterization—ensuring source data is cleansed and shaped for optimal dashboard performance.
Configure and maintain on-premises or cloud Power BI Gateways, automate incremental and full refresh schedules, and troubleshoot connectivity issues to guarantee up-to-date reporting.
Optimize report and data model performance through query folding, aggregation tables, star-schema design patterns, and best-practice visuals to minimize load times and enhance user experience.
Partner closely with stakeholders to elicit requirements, design storyboard prototypes, and iterate on layouts and visuals based on user feedback and adoption metrics.
Architect and implement end-to-end ETL pipelines in Azure Data Factory, orchestrating data ingestion, transformation, delivery, error handling, and monitoring for reliable data flows.
Develop and maintain PySpark notebooks on Azure Databricks to execute complex KPI logic, data cleansing, and aggregation workflows, supplemented by SQL scripts to validate ETL outputs and reconcile key metrics.
Provision, secure, and govern data in Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 via Unity Catalog, managing access controls, data lineage, schema evolution, and audit trails in compliance with organizational policies.
Operate within an Agile/Scrum framework—participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives—and perform root cause analyses to identify data quality and performance issues, implementing preventive measures. 
Act as a thought partner in designing analytics and reporting solutions, including advanced developments like AI/ML, NLP/NLG solutions, recommendation engines, chatbots, and virtual assistants.
Maintain comprehensive documentation and user guides for created products. 
Follow formal processes for incidents, change requests, deployments, and service requests. 
Troubleshoot complex issues, provide root cause analysis, and recommend permanent solutions.
Identify ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality. Create well designed, testable, and efficient code. Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions. Ensure processes are documented.
Work in an agile environment with the scrum team, actively participating in daily scrums and sprint planning to meet the needs of business teams by delivering solutions.
Maintain strong collaboration and relationships across the Global Development team, business teams, IT, data modeling, and architecture teams. 
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to uncover actionable insights 
Develop dashboards, reports, and presentations for leadership and business teams 
Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and identify trends or anomalies
Support strategic planning through data-driven recommendations Required 

Professional and Technical Skills required:
Power BI Desktop and Service, DAX, Power Query (M), 
Python, Apache PySpark, SQL (T-SQL, ANSI), 
Azure Data Factory, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Unity Catalog, CI/CD tools (Git, Azure DevOps), data modeling, performance tuning. 

Other Additional Information: 
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
Adaptability to changing priorities, 
Collaboration in cross-functional teams, Time management, and a continuous-learning attitude.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
CrowdStrike's engineering organization depends on shared infrastructure platforms that power critical product capabilities. These platforms need dedicated engineering ownership to operate reliably, scale safely, harden for security, and mature into self-service capabilities that teams can depend on.
You'll own production infrastructure that spans multiple cloud providers and regions, serving engineering teams across the organization. The work is equal parts platform engineering and operational excellence — building automation, hardening security, establishing governance, and enabling consuming teams to adopt these platforms effectively. You'll also help shape what comes next as the team's scope grows.
We're hiring at all seniority levels — scope and compensation adjust accordingly.
What You'll Do:
Run production infrastructure - Deploy, upgrade, and maintain platform services across multiple clouds and regions on Kubernetes.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - Make it safe and fast to ship infrastructure changes using GitOps workflows and release automation.
Build control planes - Create the APIs and tooling that make provisioning and scaling repeatable and self-service.
Own capacity planning - Track usage, forecast growth, right-size clusters, and keep infrastructure costs in check.
Build observability - Set up metrics, dashboards, and alerts using Prometheus and Grafana. Write runbooks that make on-call clear and actionable.
Own on-call and incidents - Join the on-call rotation, resolve issues, write postmortems, and turn repeat problems into automation.
Automate everything - Deployments, upgrades, certificate rotations, failover. If you do it by hand more than once, automate it.
Driving system reliability by blending software engineering principles with AI-driven automation, moving from reactive firefighting to proactive, automated operations.
Harden security - set up auth, encryption, secret rotation, and network policies. Keep dependencies patched and CVEs resolved.
Own disaster recovery - Build backup strategies, test failover, and make sure platforms can survive infrastructure failures.
Enable other teams - Provide templates, patterns, and direct support to help engineering teams use platforms reliably.
Collaborate across teams - Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Data Services on shared operational problems.
What You'll Need:
3-6 years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
Hands-on experience running stateful distributed systems on Kubernetes in production.
CI/CD experience - Building and owning pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Tekton, or similar tools.
Infrastructure-as-code skills - Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane, no manual configuration.
GitOps experience - ArgoCD or Flux for managing infrastructure deployments.
Observability skills - Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing tools like Jaeger or OpenTelemetry.
Database operations - Backup, restore, schema management, and performance tuning for relational and NoSQL databases.
Security mindset - You implement auth, encryption, secret management, and network policies as part of normal work.
Multi-cloud or multi-region experience - you have managed infrastructure across providers or regions.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Bonus Points: 
Experience running security platforms or telemetry pipelines at large scale.
Experience building internal developer platforms and self-service tooling.
Familiarity with service mesh tools like Istio or Linkerd.
Experience running workflow orchestration platforms like Temporal or Argo Workflows.
Experience running distributed tracing or telemetry infrastructure at scale.
Experience with disaster recovery automation for stateful systems.
Background at a cybersecurity or high-availability SaaS company.
Contributions to open-source projects or the broader tech community.
Go proficiency - our platforms and services are primarily written in Go.
